title: Version 3 Unified Student Dashboard & Legacy Feature Consolidation
objective: Consolidate the premier features from Legacy Mode (Japan Readiness Radar, 25-Lesson Minna no Nihongo Pathway, and Memory OS Flashcard SRS Widget) into the modern Version 3 Student Dashboard (src/v2/pages/V2DashboardPage.tsx), eliminating the need for legacy mode while providing an interactive and powerful learner experience.
in_scope: Incorporate the Japan Readiness Radar (N5, N4, Work, Relocation readiness score breakdown) directly into src/v2/pages/V2DashboardPage.tsx
Integrate the 25-Lesson Minna no Nihongo Master Pathway with visual lesson milestone nodes, gate locks, and direct lesson runner launching
Embed the Memory OS SRS active flashcard review quick-widget into the dashboard for one-click spaced-repetition retention drills
Provide high-contrast Neo-Tokyo slate aesthetics (#0a0a12) with amber/rose accents, live streaks, and JLPT target milestone progression bar
Author automated test suite scripts/test-v3-wp02-dashboard-consolidation.cjs with 100% assertions passing
out_of_scope: Changing Supabase user profile schema or mutating production database rows
Altering the strict cumulative learning lattice rules for Kana introduction
acceptance_criteria: src/v2/pages/V2DashboardPage.tsx showcases the Japan Readiness Radar with dynamic telemetry from user progress
25 Minna no Nihongo lessons pathway is interactive, displaying completed, active, and locked nodes with milestone gating
Memory OS flashcard review widget allows launching spaced repetition drills directly from the dashboard
Automated test scripts/test-v3-wp02-dashboard-consolidation.cjs passes with 100% green assertions and browser screenshot evidence
Zero typecheck errors (tsc --noEmit) and clean production build (npm run build)
verification: Headless browser DOM and visual verification of all consolidated widgets on #/dashboard
npx tsc --noEmit and npm run build
risks: Dashboard payload size or render latency (mitigated by lazy-loading heavy modal subcomponents and memoizing radar calculations)
